This is the first Grammar video of Lesson 6. We will study the possessive form in English, also called the GENITIVE CASE. Before the grammar explanation, look at these sentences about Abraham’s family tree.
1. Abraham is Sarah’s    husband  .
2. Sarah is Abraham’s   wife     .
3. Isaac is Abraham’s      son       .
4. Abraham and Sarah are Isaac’s    parents   .
5. Isaac is Esau and Jacob’s       father    .
6. Rebecca is Esau and Jacob’s       mother     .
7. Esau is Jacob’s      brother     .
8. Esau and Jacob are Rebecca’s       children / sons    .

The possessive or the genitive case in English are with ‘s. They express POSSESSION or RELATIONSHIPS. For example, McDonald’s – os primeiros donos do restaurante eram os irmãos Richard e Maurice McDonald. Porém, o ‘s também identifica um relacionamento entre duas ou mais pessoas. Quando se diz “Abraham’s wife” não significa que Sarah é posse de Abraham, mas indica o relacionamento entre eles. Use ‘s após o nome da pessoa que possui ou a natureza da relação entre a pessoa cujo nome recebe o ‘s e a outra pessoa ou pessoas.
This is Abraham’s family tree = This is the family tree of Abraham.
Abraham is Sarah’s husband = Abraham is the husband of Sarah.
Esau is Jacob’s brother = Esau is the brother of Jacob.
Atenção: As duas formas estão corretas, mas o ‘s é mais informal e mais usado no dia a dia.
Variações da regra:
When the word finishes in S, for example, Jesus, the apostrophe is optional.
Mary is Jesus’s mother. Or Mary is Jesus’ mother.
When the word is plural with -S, for example, PARENTS, you use no apostrophe.
What are your parents’ names? Abraham and Sarah.
When it’s the plural with no -S, use the apostrophe.
What are your children’s names? Esau and Jacob.
When it’s two people and one possession or relationship, the apostrophe is on the second.
Isaac is Esau and Jacob’s father. = Isaac is Esau’s father and Jacob’s father, or Isaac is the Father of Esau and the Father of Jacob.

lessons.title: The pronunciation of the letters S and Z

grammarNotes: Uma das coisas mais irregulares da língua inglesa é o seu sistema fonético. Porque inglês é uma salada de línguas que se misturaram através da história, há uma inconsistência na associação entre as letras e os fonemas. Eu sempre digo: Nunca diga sempre, nunca diga nunca.
Nessa lição vamos ver a pronúncia das letras S e Z.
A letra S pode ter som de /s/ ou /z/ no meio e no final da palavra.
Normalmente, a letra S entre duas vogais tem som de /s/, como Esau. Porém, em Jesus, Isaac e Moses, tem som de /z/.
No final das palavras, o S pode ter som de /s/ ou /z/.
Então, você terá que aprender a pronunciar o S a cada nova palavra que você aprender. Sorry!
Por enquanto, vamos ficar com essas palavras aqui dessas lições?

tasks.instruction:

grammarNotes: TUTOR         STUDENT
I have long hair. = My hair is long.
You have short hair. = Your hair is short.
He has long hair. = His hair is long.
She has long hair. = Her hair is long.
We have short hair. = Our hair is short.
They have short hair. = Their hair is short.
This lesson is about another possessive form. In Lesson 6, we learned the genitive case. In Lesson 7, we’ll learn the POSSESSIVE ADJECTIVES.
Look at the sentence:
I HAVE BROWN HAIR. = My hair is brown.

Em português, o adjetivo possessivo depende de quem e do que se possui. Por exemplo, meu cabelo, minha casa. Depende também do número, singular e plural, minha casa, minhas casas. Sendo assim, em português temos quatro pronomes para cada pessoa: meu, minha, meus, minhas. Usando os termos técnicos, os possessivos em português variam em gênero, número e grau. Inglês é tão mais fácil!! In English, possessive adjectives depend ONLY on the subject, em quem possui.
Look at the examples.
I have long hair. = My hair is long.
You have short hair. = Your hair is short.
He has long hair. = His hair is long.
She has long hair. = Her hair is long.
We have short hair. = Our hair is short.
They have short hair. = Their hair is short.

lessons.title: Reading and Vocabulary – Is there an ark in the Holy Place?

grammarNotes: Describing Places
The name of this lesson is – Is there an ark in the Holy Place?
In Lesson 7 we learned how to describe people. In this lesson, we’ll learn how to describe places.

A very special place in the Old Testament is the Tabernacle, the temple of the Jewish people. It has a sanctuary in the desert. There is a very detailed description of the Tabernacle in Exodus Chapter 26-38.
The Tabernacle has three parts – The Most Holy Place, the Holy Place, and the Courtyard.
There are some objects in the Tabernacle – an ark – a basin – an altar of incense – a table – a lampstand – an altar of burnt offerings
Read the text, look at the pictures and locate the objects in the three parts of the Tabernacle.
The Tabernacle

The tabernacle is a sanctuary in the desert - a place of adoration. It is divided  into three parts: The Most Holy Place, The Holy Place and The Courtyard. In the Most Holy Place there is an ark. There are two cherubim on the ark, and it represents the presence  and the glory of God.

There is a curtain that divides the Most Holy Place and the Holy Place. In the Holy Place there are three objects: an altar of incense, a table, and a lampstand.  In the courtyard, there are two objects: a basin and an altar of burnt offerings.

grammarNotes: Do you remember the vocabulary about the objects in the Tabernacle? Now, find these sentences about the objects in the Tabernacle in the text. These sentences start with THERE IS or THERE ARE.
And the answers are:
In the Most Holy Place there is an ark.
There are two cherubim on the ark.
There is a curtain.
In the Holy Place there are three objects.
In the courtyard, there are two objects.

This is the verb THERE TO BE. The verb THERE TO BE has only two forms in English. The singular form - "There is" - and the plural form - "There are". Esse verbo equivale ao verbo "haver, existir ou ter" em português. Quer dizer que existe, há ou tem alguma coisa em algum determinado lugar. For example,
There are two cherubim on the ark. ˭ Tem / Há dois querubins na arca.
In the AFFIRMATIVE form, use "there is" for singular. Normally, there is a/an.
There is an ark In the Most Holy Place.
There is a curtain.
Use “there are” for plural.
There are two cherubim on the ark.
In the Holy Place there are three objects.
In the courtyard there are two objects.
There is not a contraction for “there are”.
In the NEGATIVE form, add NOT after the verb to be or NO before a noun, for example,
There is not a basin in the Holy place.
There’s NO lamp.
Contractions
There’s not or There isn’t

grammarNotes: One more thing about the verb THERE TO BE and quantity. Vamos aprender a usar o There to be com outras expressões que dão ideia de quantity: some - any - no
Aprendemos a usar o There to be para quantidades específicas
There is a lamp in the classroom.
There is an ark in the Most Holy Place
There are two cherubim on the ark.
Mas e se the quantity não for exata? Nesse caso, na forma afirmativa usamos SOME para pequenas quantidades.
There are some desks in the classroom.
Maybe four, five, ten?
In the question, you always use A or AN (for the singular) or ANY (for the plural):
Is there A window in the classroom? (singular)
Are there any men in the class? (plural)
To give an idea of ZERO quantity, use NO (singular or plural) or NOT ANY (plural)
There’s NO phone service here. (singular)
There’s NO problem. (singular)
There are NO windows in the classroom. = There aren’t any windows. (plural)

grammarNotes: The name of this lesson is “How many books are there in the Bible?”

In this lesson, we’ll learn about the PLURAL and to ask questions about QUANTITY. For example, in the Bible, there are two parts, right? The Old Testament and the New Testament. How many books are there in the Old Testament? And how many books are there in the New Testament?
I’ll give you some time to think.
The answers are:
There are 39 books in the Old Testament.
There are 27 books in the New Testament.

When you ask a question with HOW MANY, the noun after the expression HOW MANY is always in the plural. HOW MANY BOOKS? The answer is in the singular or in the plural, so we need to learn the PLURAL FORM of the nouns in English.
English and Portuguese are similar in that you add the suffix -S, but there are some variations and exceptions.
1. The plural of a noun is usually made by adding s to the singular form.
2. When the word ends in a CONSONANT + Y, drop the Y  and add -ies
3. After o, ch, sh, s, ss or x add es
waitress – waitresses / tax – taxes / actress – actresses / tomato – tomatoes / watch – watches
4. Some nouns have irregular forms.
Now let’s do an exercise. Form questions and answer them.
For example: 1. window / in your room – How many windows are there in your room?
2. person / in your family
3. man / in your family
4. woman / in your family
5. country / North America
6. continent / world
7. brother and sister / do you have
ANSWERS
The numbers in your answers vary, but the sentences are:
2. How many people (or persons) are there in your family? There are ___ people in my family.
3. How many men are there in your family? There are ___ men.
4. How many women are there in your family? There are ___ women in my family
5. How many countries are there in North America? There are 3 countries.
6 How many continents are there in the world? There are 5 continents.
7 How many brothers and sisters do you have? I have ___ brother(s) and ____ sister(s).

grammarNotes: Still about “Books in the Bible”, let’s expand this information.
The Bible is divided into two parts, right? The Old and the New Testament.
The Old Testament is divided into 3 parts:
The Law, the Prophets and the Writings.
The New Testament is divided into 4 parts:
The Gospels, the Acts of the Apostles, the Epistles, and Prophecy
Listen to the passage and complete with the number of books in each part.

The word Bible is a Greek word that means “book”, but the Bible is not one book. It is a collection of many books. The Christian Bible is divided into two major sections – the Old Testament and the New Testament. The OT has 39 books and is divided into 4 parts: The Law, the Prophets, History Books, and the Writings. The Law is composed of 5 books that were written by Moses, also called the Torah, the Pentateuch or the books of Moses. The prophets are a group of 17 books of men who spoke to the nation on behalf of God. The historical books are books that describe the history of the Jewish people. The Writings are 5 books that include history, songs, poems, stories and wisdom.

The NT is composed of 4 different kinds of books: the 4 gospels, one book called the Acts of the apostles, telling the history of the early church, 21 epistles or letters and one prophetic book called Revelation.
